specification/reference/instances.metaDescription: AAP API reference for instances: provision, retrieve, update and delete agent instances, with the request and response schemas for each operation.

specification/reference/requests.metaDescription: AAP API reference for approval requests: submit a proposed tool call, retrieve its outcome or cancel it, with the full request and response schemas.

specification/reference/webhooks.metaDescription: AAP API reference for webhooks: verify webhook receivers and notify them when approval requests reach a terminal state, with payload schemas.

specification/reference/schemas.metaDescription: Every object, type and constraint defined by the AAP OpenAPI contract, including instances, approval requests, decisions and webhook payloads.

specification/reference/openapi.metaDescription: Read or download the complete AAP OpenAPI 3.1 contract in YAML, the source of truth for every operation, field and type in the protocol.
